definitions.gloss: handouts; distributed materials; printed materials for distribution
definitions.explanation: Documents, flyers, or other materials that are given out at meetings, classes, events, or other gatherings.

examples.japanese: {配布物|はいふぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{配布物|はいふぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なくしてしまった。
examples.english: I lost the handouts from class.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{配布物|はいふぶつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{事前|じぜん}→事前：07580_jizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}ります→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{各自|かくじ}→各自：00157_kakuji⟧⟦{印刷|いんさつ}して→印刷する：21677_insatsusuru⟧お⟦{持|も}ち→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: The meeting handouts will be sent by email in advance, so please print them out and bring them with you.

notes:
USAGE:
Common in school, university, and business meeting contexts. Can refer to physical printouts or digital documents shared with participants.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配布物|はいふぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}る→配る：03921_kubaru⟧ (to distribute handouts)
- {配布物|はいふぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧ (to receive handouts)
- ⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{配布物|はいふぶつ} (class handouts)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦プリント→プリント：01539_purinto⟧: printout/handout — more casual, commonly used by students
- ⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧: materials/documents — broader term that includes handouts but also reference materials
